title: 第一卷 第25章 青国来人第一卷 第26章 密信
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
【侦察隐匿（入门）：30200】
【效果：寻踪识途，隐匿气息】
在【侦察隐匿】技能迈入入门境界之后，李毅对信息的搜集能力越发强悍。
在翻找战利品的时候，从叶间透过的阳光洒在林间，光辉一闪，李毅下意识瞥了一眼，却见这衣袍角落处，有着一个淡淡的榕树纹。
青国崇拜榕树，其国以榕树为纹章。
看着这衣服上的榕树纹章，李毅心中一动，连番翻看二人的手指。
“这些老茧，是常年握持武器训练才能留下来的。”
想到此处，李毅心中一震，结合诸多信息，他瞬间明白。
这两个人，是青国派来的间谍！
“但是我只是一个尚未通过新人考核的新人，根本接触不到军事机密，也只是一个猎户出身，按理来说，根本不会被这些间谍列为目标啊！”
意识到这二人是间谍后，李毅连忙将有可能暴露自身信息的痕迹，通通清理干净，旋即在尸体上撒上诱兽药后，便快速远离现场。
百木林虽然名为林，但其实是一片群山。
奔走一个时辰后，李毅藏身在一个山洞中，取出肉干补充着能量。
在奔逃期间，李毅一直在思考，这两个间谍究竟为何要设伏暗杀自己。
曹立？还是户曹?
李毅一边吃着肉干，一边思索着。
“等等，那户曹为什么一直急着招揽我，甚至不惜要拿我家人来威胁？”
按理讲，自己为人比较正直，在黑石镇多以木讷示人，户曹想要给他办脏事的跑腿，首选不应该是我啊！
一想到此，李毅对户曹的怀疑越发浓烈。
结合替户曹办事的王大贵，死在了自己手中，李毅心中冒出一个猜测。

难道这户曹暗中与青国有勾结，而王大贵便是替户曹跑腿办事的人，手里掌握了一些户曹与青国来往的证据。
而自己是杀死王大贵的最大嫌疑人，因此户曹害怕自己拿到那个证据，故而才想要将自己招揽到门下。
但是自己几次拒绝了户曹的招揽，恼羞成怒的户曹急于摧毁证据，所以便联系青国间谍，想要利用百木林的考核，将自己弄死。
忽地，李毅想到吴川生曾经说过，往日的新人考核，监管官等都只是走个过场，不会亲自进入考核地。
但这一次，诸多监考官，都亲自带队巡逻。
看来，便是因为户曹想要最快速度确认自己身死，才来百木林中督战。
想到这里，李毅原本就想要弄死户曹的心，越发坚定了。
“不过当务之急，是先将任务完成。”
“在完成任务的同时，不断增进【侦察隐匿】技能的经验，顺势找到户曹的踪迹，将其给弄死！”
心中有了计划后，李毅快速吃完手中的肉干，便握着破军弓，离开山洞，在山林中搜寻着野兽踪迹。
数百人散在百木林中，连水花都激不起来。
李毅以这处山洞为据点，依托【狩猎】与【侦察隐匿】两个技能，不过一日的功夫，便猎杀到了两只大野猪，四只野狼，一只猛虎。
再猎到一只熊瞎子，与一只大蟒蛇，便可以完成这一项任务。
但第一天的好运，似乎耗尽了李毅全部的运气。
第二天一整个白天，李毅都没有发现任何大型猛兽的踪迹。
“看来这一片的霸主，都被我杀完了。”
叹了口气，李毅将山洞中的猎物收获，都收入行囊中，离开了山洞。
对于这些强大的野兽而言，彼此间都会划分一个捕猎的地盘。
这两日，李毅差不多将分布在这里的猛兽杀完了，要想猎到熊与蛇，只能离开去一片新的山林中寻找。
将兽皮兽爪等背在身后，李毅看着面前的山林，开始思考起来。

再猛的凶兽，都离不开食物。
鹿羊等能提供大量肉食的动物，都生活在水草丰盛之处。
content_en:
[Reconnaissance and concealment (entry): 30200]
[Effectiveness: Find the trail and identify the path, conceal the breath]
After the [Reconnaissance and Concealment] skill entered the entry level, Li Yi's ability to collect information became even more powerful.
While rummaging through the trophies, the sunlight shining through the leaves shone in the forest, and Li Yi glanced subconsciously, only to see a faint banyan tree pattern in the corner of the robe.
Qing State worships the banyan tree and uses the banyan tree as its coat of arms.
Looking at the banyan tree emblem on the clothes, Li Yi's heart moved and he looked at their fingers repeatedly.
"These calluses are the result of years of training with weapons."
Thinking of this, Li Yi was shocked. Combining a lot of information, he understood instantly.
These two people are spies sent by Qingguo!
"But I am just a newcomer who has not yet passed the newcomer assessment. I have no access to military secrets at all. I am also only an Orion. Logically speaking, I will not be listed as a target by these spies!"
After realizing that these two people were spies, Li Yi quickly cleaned up all traces that might expose his information. He immediately sprinkled animal bait on the corpse and quickly left the scene.
Although Baimulin is called Lin, it is actually a group of mountains.
After running for an hour, Li Yi hid in a cave and took out dried meat to replenish energy.
While on the run, Li Yi kept thinking about why the two spies set up an ambush to assassinate him.
Cao Li? Or Hucao?
Li Yi was thinking while eating dried meat.
"Wait a minute, why is that Hu Cao so eager to recruit me that he even threatens my family?"
Logically speaking, I am a relatively upright person, and I often appear dull to others in Black Rock Town. If Hucao wants to run errands for him, I shouldn't be his first choice!
Thinking of this, Li Yi became more suspicious of Hu Cao.
Combined with the fact that Wang Dagui, who was working for Hu Cao, died in his own hands, Li Yi had a guess in his mind.
Could it be that Hu Cao secretly colluded with the Qing State, and Wang Dagui was the person who ran errands for Hu Cao, and he had some evidence of Hu Cao's dealings with the Qing State.
And he was the biggest suspect in killing Wang Dagui, so Hucao was afraid that he would get the evidence, so he wanted to recruit him.
However, he refused Hucao's solicitation several times. Hucao became angry and eager to destroy the evidence, so he contacted Qingguo spies and wanted to use Baimulin's assessment to kill himself.
Suddenly, Li Yi remembered that Wu Chuansheng once said that in the past newbie assessment, supervisors and others were just a formality and would not enter the assessment site in person.
But this time, many invigilators personally led patrols.
It seems that Hu Cao came to Baimu Forest to supervise the battle because he wanted to confirm his death as quickly as possible.
Thinking of this, Li Yi's original intention to kill Hu Cao became more determined.
"But the top priority is to complete the task first."
"While completing the mission, continue to improve your [Reconnaissance and Concealment] skill experience, find Hucao's traces, and kill him!"
With a plan in mind, Li Yi quickly finished the dried meat in his hand, then held the broken army bow and left the cave, searching for traces of wild beasts in the forest.
Hundreds of people were scattered in the forest, and even the water splash could not stir up.
Li Yi used this cave as his base and relied on the two skills of [Hunting] and [Reconnaissance and Concealment]. In just one day, he hunted two large wild boars, four wild wolves, and a tiger.
If you hunt a blind bear and a big python, you can complete this mission.
But the good luck on the first day seemed to have exhausted all Li Yi's luck.
Throughout the whole day the next day, Li Yi found no trace of any large beasts.
"It seems that I have killed all the overlords in this area."
Sighing, Li Yi collected all the prey in the cave into his bag and left the cave.
For these powerful beasts, each other isWill divide a hunting territory.
In the past two days, Li Yi had almost killed all the beasts scattered here. If he wanted to hunt bears and snakes, he could only leave and search in a new mountain forest.
Carrying the animal skins, claws, etc. behind his back, Li Yi looked at the mountains and forests in front of him and began to think.
No matter how fierce the beast is, it cannot do without food.
Animals that can provide a lot of meat, such as deer and sheep, live in places with abundant water and grass.
